title: AI-prioritized celastrol covalently engages SMAD3 in diabetic kidney disease models
summary: Experiments showed celastrol covalently engages SMAD3 at Cys421, altering nuclear translocation and SMAD3-SMAD4 association in diabetic kidney disease models, using activity-based protein profiling, a competitive probe assay and site-directed mutagenesis. AI contributed to prioritizing a known compound; the mechanistic claims rest on the experiments.
ai_technology: Uni-Mol deep learning platform used to prioritize celastrol as a candidate target modulator
organization: Guiyang Medical University; Affiliated Hospital of Guizhou Medical University
